principle: Preserve agents.autonomy_ceiling legacy L-values; replace only the six primary permission-profile write_ceiling texts with canonical A-level semantics. No numeric L-to-A mapping.

agents.target_write_ceiling: A3 default for reasoning/preparation/internal control state; A4 only for an explicitly approved workflow/action with connector authority; A5/A6 only per separately proven workflow; no global A5/A6 grant.

A3 default for guest reasoning/draft; routine low-risk external sends/actions remain A4 until a specific runtime-verified workflow earns bounded A5; refunds/cancellations/reservation/payment/exception actions remain human-gated or prohibited by policy.

A3 default for operational analysis/preparation; approved low-risk digital workflow writes may use A4 and later A5 only after workflow verification; physical work remains human unless separately automated; reservation/safety/material-spend/disciplinary/contract actions remain gated.

A3 default for analysis/reconciliation/preparation; low-risk governed metadata writes may use A4 and later bounded A5 only if verified; payments/refunds/tax filing/payroll approval or payment/binding accounting/legal actions remain human or professional gated.

A3 default for research/offer/campaign/content preparation; publication/campaign changes require A4 unless a specific reversible workflow earns bounded A5; spend/billing/provider contracts/unverified public claims remain gated.

A3 default for inspect/design/prepare and isolated build work; approved reversible system writes use A4; A5 only for tested low-risk automation with rollback/observability; production-risk deploys/destructive migration/permissions/security/secrets/domain-account ownership remain gated.
